Application Number: 23085-T1

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT FOR
2721-2733 NORTH PAULINA ST., CHICAGO

The subject property is currently a vacant parcel measuring 195” x 124.48’. The Applicant intends
to subdivide this vacant parcel into six new zoning lots (with varying lot widths between 30’ and
33.75”) and redevelop each new zoning lot with either a new two-story or three-story single-
family house, per the Type | Plans attached. A zoning change is required to allow residential use
at the subject property and to comply with the bulk regulations of the RT4 District. With this
application, the Applicant is also seeking optional variation relief for front and side setback
reductions, per the Type 1 Plans attached.
